exposure: Patients with labor epidural catheters in situ
Race/ethnicity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, non-Hispanic White, other)
outcome: Rate of general anesthesia for cesarean delivery
cohort: 35,117 patients who underwent cesarean delivery at Northwestern Medicine's Prentice Women's Hospital from January 1, 2007, to March 2, 2018
finding: While racial disparities persist in the overall use of general anesthesia for cesarean delivery, they were not observed among women who had epidural catheters placed during labor.
